image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a disposable plastic lighter lying on a textured black surface with white line-art patterns. The lighter has a translucent blue base and a red mesh-textured grip area. The top ignition mechanism is visible but appears slightly distorted or melted into the background. The background is out of focus, showing blurred figures and greenery.
